verdict.rationale: LobeChat/LobeHub documents multiple distinct agents with their own profiles (editable Markdown), models, and workspaces (docs-6/19/28/41/42/53), plus channel-style routing via IM Gateway/Messenger integrations for Telegram, Slack, Discord (docs-25/33/55) and shared team workspaces for collaboration. This covers the core of running and routing multiple agents, though the evidence is largely marketing/changelog copy rather than deep technical documentation of per-agent workspace isolation or routing rules. Missing for 10: detailed technical docs on how routing/assignment logic works, independent hands-on verification of multi-agent workspace isolation, and concrete examples of channel-to-agent mapping configuration.
